purpose: Test continuation tokens and generation beyond the observed 32768-token batch boundary; not a benchmark recovery run
cost_bound_assumptions: At most two 1048576-token input windows at $2/M plus 128000 total output tokens at $10/M = $5.474304; recheck prices, context and cumulative accounting before execution. No automatic retries.
resume_rule: Only for native CONTINUATION with remaining budget, resend original user message unchanged plus last assistant message carrying the latest opaque continuation item. Keep max_tokens=128000; no additional user turn.
success_evidence: Continuation item received and successfully replayed; cumulative generated output exceeds 32768, or a subsequent hop produces a normal final answer. A first-hop normal answer alone does not validate continuation.
retention: Write every exact non-secret request and raw response before proceeding; store opaque continuation items locally, do not print them. Preserve old results unchanged.
production_followup: Opt-in bounded continuation loop for direct transport
All-hop raw artifacts and usage accounting with validation and publication support
Fail closed on continuation without token
Do not present diagnostic output as an official benchmark score
